description: Before paying an x402 URL or seller domain: one label from the same data and signing key as Lumi's free /v1/check: checks_passed (Delivered in recent checks), check_first (Check first), checks_failed (Recent checks failed) or no_data (Not enough data), with as-of date, evidence window, conclusive test-buy count, last delivered/failed dates, reason codes, evidence and appeal links, and observed on-chain payments as ranges only. It is the one-word version of the live check: label_live is the label after Lumi contacts the seller at call time (an unpaid request) and compares its quote, price, payTo and TLS with Lumi's record, with signed live_evidence. Costs $0.01 per call, paid with your wallet within the configured caps. Paying Lumi never changes a result. Observations, not a guarantee.

amount.description: Optional: the quoted price in USD, e.g. 0.01

payTo.description: Optional: the payTo address in its 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL (or the seller's domain) you are about to pay

title: Lumi: one-label pre-payment check
